svg.aria-label: Removing the camera ribbon from its FPC connector

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Getting the old camera off — the FPC latch

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The ribbon is clamped by a tiny latch. Until that latch is open the ribbon will not move, and pulling on it tears the contacts off

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: or rips the connector off the board. Two latch styles exist; find yours first.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: THE GOLDEN RULE: if it needs force, you are moving the wrong part, or the wrong way. Every step here is fingertip-light.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Flip-lock (most common)

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A thin dark flap hinged at the BACK edge.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: board

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: connector body

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ribbon

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: closed

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: rotates UP ~90°

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hinge at the far edge

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Get a fingernail under the flap's FRONT edge (the ribbon

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side) and rotate it up and back. It stops with a light click.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Travel: about a quarter turn. That's all.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: B

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Slide-lock

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A collar that slides straight back, flat and parallel.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: board

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: connector body

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ribbon

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: closed

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: slides back ~1 mm

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Push the collar AWAY from the ribbon with two nails, one

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at each end, a little at a time so it doesn't cock sideways.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Travel: about a millimetre. It stays parallel.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Whichever you have

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Photograph the seated ribbon first — which face the silver contacts point toward is the thing you cannot look up later.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Work under bright light with your phone camera zoomed in. These parts are ~1 mm; you are not going to do this by feel.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Fingernails or a plastic spudger/toothpick only. Metal tweezers slip, gouge the board and short things.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Lift or push BOTH ENDS evenly, alternating in small steps. Levering one corner is what snaps latches.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 5. With the latch open the ribbon slides out with ZERO force — pinch it flat and draw it straight back. If it resists, the latch is not open.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 6. Hold the BOARD, never the ribbon or the connector, and keep it flat on the desk while you work.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If the ribbon is free but the module still won't lift

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Many camera modules are also stuck down with a foam pad or double-sided tape. Ease it up slowly from one edge rather

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: than pulling — you have three spare modules, but only one connector.
